name: forget
description: DELETE/REMOVE a memory permanently. Use when user says 'forget', 'delete', 'remove', or 'erase' a memory. Can search by keywords if memory_id unknown. This is for DELETION - use update_memory if you need to CHANGE a value instead.

memory_id.description: The ID of the memory to delete (optional if search_query provided)

search_query.description: Search keywords to find the memory to delete (e.g., 'favorite color', 'birthday'). Used if memory_id not provided.
